CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audience_list(p_workspace uuid, p_q text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tag text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF zoi.audience_contacts
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zoi', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM zoi.assert_ws(p_workspace);
  RETURN QUERY SELECT * FROM zoi.audience_contacts c
  WHERE c.workspace_id=p_workspace
    AND (p_q IS NULL OR c.name ILIKE '%'||p_q||'%' OR c.email ILIKE '%'||p_q||'%' OR c.phone ILIKE '%'||p_q||'%')
    AND (p_tag IS NULL OR p_tag = ANY(c.tags))
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 500;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.assert_ws(p_ws uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin perform zoi.workspace_current_role(p_ws);end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.audience_asset_role(p_workspace uuid, p_lock boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_lock then return zoi.workspace_locked_role(p_workspace);end if;
 return zoi.workspace_current_role(p_workspace);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.ops_role(p_workspace uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT CASE
 WHEN wm.profile_id IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN w.owner_profile_id=up.id THEN 'owner' END
 WHEN wm.role='owner'AND w.owner_profile_id IS DISTINCT FROM up.id THEN 'viewer'
 WHEN wm.role IN('owner','admin','editor','viewer')THEN wm.role END
 FROM zoi.workspaces w JOIN zoi.user_profiles up ON up.auth_user_id=auth.uid()
 LEFT JOIN zoi.workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=w.id AND wm.profile_id=up.id
 WHERE w.id=p_workspace;
$function$
